There is an alternative to evaluate the query type regardless of position, using [`sqlparse.parse(value)[0].get_type()` (docs)](https://sqlparse.readthedocs.io/en/latest/analyzing/#sqlparse.sql.Statement.get_type) from the [sqlparse](https://pypi.org/project/sqlparse/) package we can validate that.

issue_context.title: SQL integration not allowing use of valid queries
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I wrote a query that is a little more advanced as it needs to grabs the last value of a sensor for each day. I'm doing this in a `WITH` clause. I have executed this query against my PSQL Database that HomeAssistant is using and it returns quickly and as expected. However when I put this query in as a sensor I get the following error `Only SELECT queries allowed for dictionary value @ data['sql'][0]['query']....`

Below is the raw query and below that is what I have in my `sql.yaml` file

```sql
WITH ranked_data AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE((to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)::timestamp with time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')) ORDER BY (to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)::timestamp with time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles') DESC) AS row_num
  FROM states
  WHERE metadata_id = 297 AND state != 'unknown' AND state != 'unavailable' AND state != '0.0'
)

SELECT ROUND(sum(state::float)::numeric, 2) AS rain
FROM ranked_data
WHERE row_num = 1 AND DATE(to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)) > '2023-08-20' AND DATE(to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)) < '2024-07-01' 
LIMIT 1;
```

**sql.yaml**
```yaml
- name: 'Rain 2023-2024'
  query: >
    WITH ranked_data AS (
      SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE((to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)::timestamp with time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')) ORDER BY (to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)::timestamp with time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles') DESC) AS row_num
      FROM states
      where metadata_id = 297 AND state != 'unknown' AND state != 'unavailable' AND state != '0.0'
    )
    SELECT ROUND(sum(state::float)::numeric, 2) AS rain
    FROM ranked_data
    WHERE row_num = 1 AND DATE(to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)) > '2023-08-20' AND DATE(to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)) < '2024-07-01'
    LIMIT 1;
  column: "rain"
```

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.10.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

SQL

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sql/

### Diagnostics information

Full error:
```
Invalid config for [sql]: Only SELECT queries allowed for dictionary value @ data['sql'][0]['query']. Got "WITH ranked_data AS (\n SELECT\n *,\n ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE((to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)::timestamp with time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')) ORDER BY (to_timestamp(last_updated_ts)::timestamp with time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles') DESC) AS row_num\n FROM states\n where metadata_id = 297 AND state != 'unknown' AND state != 'unavailable' AND state != '0.0'\n) SELECT ROUND(sum(state::float)::numeric, 2) AS rain FROM ranked_data WHERE row_num = 1 .... (See /config/configuration.yaml, line 27).
```
